name: Abhishek Saikia
bio_short: I write about technology, system internals and design, and the ideas shaping how we live. I also build tools, learn through experiments, and share my occasional thoughts.
bio_long: I'm Abhishek Saikia, a programmer and thinker based in India. I am a fresh graduate for the year 2026. I think carefully about technology, language, and how people make sense of the world.

I delve in backend and systems engineering, ranging from distributed systems and cloud to the internals of a computer. Currently comfortable in Go, Typescript, Python and a bit of Rust and C. I wish to dive deeper into their internals and learn more about them.
I write here irregularly but with intention.
If something I've written resonated with you, I'd genuinely love to hear about it.
